description:
Get the paper portfolio's closed trades from resolved books, newest first, market-cap-weighted ("cap", the
    default) or equal-weighted ("equal"): the two trade at the same prices and differ in weight, and so in size and
    P&L. Open positions never appear. Date bounds apply to the day a trade opened; narrow them to see past the limit.
    Use this for individual trades, and get_simulation_nav for portfolio value.

from_date.description: Earliest date to include, as YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for no lower bound.
from_date.title: From Date

limit.description: Most trades to return, 1 to 500. Default 500. Older trades are cut off; there is no paging.
limit.title: Limit

to_date.description: Latest date to include, as YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for no upper bound.
to_date.title: To Date

weighting.description: "cap" for market-cap weights against SPY (the default), or "equal" for equal weights against RSP.
weighting.title: Weighting

name: get_simulation_trades
title: Portfolio trades
